questions.q: For the imaginary unit \( i \), where \( i^2 = -1 \), which of the following is equivalent to the expression \( (5 - 2i)(3 + 4i) \)?
questions.answer:
To multiply the two complex numbers, apply the distributive property (FOIL method):

\[
(5 - 2i)(3 + 4i) = (5)(3) + (5)(4i) + (-2i)(3) + (-2i)(4i)
\]

Compute each term:
- First: \( 5 \times 3 = 15 \)
- Outside: \( 5 \times 4i = 20i \)
- Inside: \( -2i \times 3 = -6i \)
- Last: \( -2i \times 4i = -8i^2 \)

Substitute \( i^2 = -1 \):
\[
-8i^2 = -8(-1) = 8
\]

Now, group and combine the real and imaginary components:
\[
\text{Real part: } 15 + 8 = 23
\]
\[
\text{Imaginary part: } 20i - 6i = 14i
\]

Thus, the product is \( 23 + 14i \).

- Choice B (\( 7 + 14i \)) arises from incorrectly assuming \( i^2 = 1 \), giving \( 15 - 8 = 7 \).
- Choice C (\( 23 + 26i \)) arises from failing to distribute the negative sign to \( -2i \times 3 \), giving \( 20i + 6i = 26i \).
- Choice D (\( 7 - 14i \)) combines multiple sign errors.

questions.q: What is \( i^4 \)?
questions.answer: Applying Complex Numbers principles, \( i^4=(i^2)^2=(-1)^2=1 \). Therefore, the verified correct option is \(1\).

questions.q: Simplify \( (2+3i)+(5-i) \).
questions.answer: Add real and imaginary parts separately: \( (2+5)+(3-1)i=7+2i \).
Applying Complex Numbers principles, \( (4-1)+(-2-3)i=3-5i \). Therefore, the verified correct option is \(3-5i\).

questions.q: What is the imaginary part of \( z=6-7i \)?
questions.answer: The imaginary part is the real coefficient of \( i \), which is \( -7 \).

questions.q: Simplify \( i\cdot i\cdot i \).
questions.answer: Applying Complex Numbers principles, \( i^3=i^2\cdot i=(-1)(i)=-i \). Therefore, the verified correct option is \(-i\).

questions.q: Simplify \( 3i\cdot4i \).
questions.answer: Applying Complex Numbers principles, \( 3i\cdot4i=12i^2=12(-1)=-12 \). Therefore, the verified correct option is \(-12\).

questions.q: What is the complex conjugate of \( 5-2i \)?
questions.answer: The conjugate flips the sign of the imaginary part only: \( 5-2i\to5+2i \).

questions.q: Multiply \( (2+i)(3-i) \).
Simplify \( \dfrac{1+i}{1-i} \).
questions.answer: Multiply by the conjugate: \( \dfrac{(1+i)^2}{(1-i)(1+i)}=\dfrac{2i}{2}=i \).

questions.q: Simplify \( i^7 \).
questions.answer: Powers of \( i \) cycle every 4: \( i^7=i^{4}\cdot i^3=1\cdot(-i)=-i \).

questions.q: If \( (x+2)+(y-3)i=5+4i \) for real \( x,y \), find \( x+y \).
questions.answer: Equate real and imaginary parts: \( x+2=5\Rightarrow x=3 \); \( y-3=4\Rightarrow y=7 \). So \( x+y=10 \).

questions.q: Simplify \( (2-3i)^2 \).
If \( z=4+3i \), find \( z\bar z \).
questions.answer: Applying Complex Numbers principles, \( z\bar z=|z|^2=4^2+3^2=16+9=25 \). Therefore, the verified correct option is \(25\).
